You can see an opened fridge. The fridge contains a raw pork chop and a white onion. Is this what you came to TextWorld for? This... fridge? You see an oven. You make out a table. Unfortunately, there isn't a thing on it. Hm. Oh well You can make out a counter. You see a red apple and a cookbook on the counter. You see a gleam over in a corner, where you can see a stove. Looks like someone's already been here and taken everything off it, though.

There is a closed sliding patio door leading east. There is a closed plain door leading north. There is an exit to the west. Don't worry, there is no door.
